units.title: 疾病专看用爻：用爻有气、元神发动、忌神安静便无妨；忌神动而元神同发则转助用爻；元神不动闲神休囚又被月建日辰克也主倾危

rule.yi: 以用神为主，元神为凭。占疾病，必须求用象兴旺；元神旺相又发动，一定亨通；忌神千万不要在发动的位置上；日、月到来，要配合它的克与生；动的要看变爻才知道去留；没有（用象）就找伏象，才知道亏盈。注说：凡是占疾病，专看用爻，卦里如果用爻有气、元神发动、忌神安静，就没有妨碍；忌神怕动，但如果元神同时发动，转过来帮助用爻，病反而安稳；卦里元神不动，闲神又休囚，再遇上月建或日辰来克，也主倾危。
rule.en: The Subject is the main line, and the Support is the ground. In illness one must seek a thriving Subject image; the Support strong and moving surely means success; the Adversary must on no account be in a moving position; when the Day and Month arrive, match them with their control and generation; for a moving line look at the changed line to know whether it goes or stays; if there is none, search for a hidden image to sense its waning and waxing. The commentary says: in divining illness look only at the Subject line; if in the hexagram the Subject line has qi, the Support moves and the Adversary is still, there is no obstruction; the Adversary should not move, but if the Support moves with it, it turns to help the Subject line and the illness on the contrary settles; if the Support in the hexagram does not move, the idle spirits are resting or trapped, and the Month or Day also controls it, danger of collapse is indicated.

zh: 以用神为主，元神为凭。
yi: 以用神为主，以元神为凭。
en: The Subject is the main line, and the Support is the ground.

zh: 疾病须求用象兴，元神旺动定为亨，
忌神切莫交重位，日月将来配克生，
动看变爻知去就，无寻伏象觉亏盈。
yi: 占疾病，必须求用象兴旺；元神旺相又发动，一定亨通；
忌神千万不要在发动的位置上；日、月到来，要配合它的克与生；
动的要看变爻，才知道去留；没有（用象）就找伏象，才知道亏盈。
en: In illness one must seek a thriving Subject image; the Support strong and moving surely means success;
the Adversary must on no account be in a moving position; when the Day and Month arrive, match them with their control and generation;
for a moving line look at the changed line to know whether it goes or stays; if there is none, search for a hidden image to sense its waning and waxing.

zh: 凡占疾病专看用爻，卦中若得用爻有气元神发动、忌神安静，便主无妨。
忌神忌动，如元神同发者，转助用爻，病反得详。
卦内元神不动，闲神况值休囚，更逢月建或日辰相克，也主倾危。
yi: 凡是占疾病，专看用爻：卦里如果用爻有气、元神发动、忌神安静，就主没有妨碍。
忌神怕动，但如果元神同时发动，转过来帮助用爻，病反而安稳。
卦里元神不动，闲神又休囚，再遇上月建或日辰来克，也主倾危。
en: In divining illness, look only at the Subject line: if in the hexagram the Subject line has qi, the Support moves and the Adversary is still, there is no obstruction.
The Adversary should not move, but if the Support moves with it, it turns to help the Subject line, and the illness on the contrary settles.
If the Support in the hexagram does not move, the idle spirits are resting or trapped, and the Month or Day also controls it, danger of collapse is indicated.

note.yi: 这一段没有章题；小标「以用神为主，元神为凭」说的是整章的取法：占病主看用神，凭据是元神。「用象」「用爻」「主象」在这一段里是用神的别称。「闲神」是与用神既不相生也不相克的爻。「无寻伏象」的「无」是没有用象时才去找伏象。与黄金策「主衰得助重亦何妨」（LY.ILL.HJC.48）、增删卜易「用绝逢生危而有救」（LY.ILL.ZS.13）是同一路读法。
note.en: This passage has no chapter title; the subtitle 'the Subject is the main line, the Support the ground' gives the method for the whole: in divining illness the Subject is the chief, and the Support is what one relies on. 'Subject image', 'Subject line' and 'chief image' are other names for the Subject in this passage. 'Idle spirits' are lines that neither generate nor control the Subject. 'If there is none, search for a hidden image' means the hidden image is looked for only when there is no Subject image. It reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's 'the chief weak but helped, however heavy what matter' (LY.ILL.HJC.48) and the Zengshan Buyi's 'the Subject in Extinction meeting generation, danger yet rescue' (LY.ILL.ZS.13).

units.title: 用象强弱与变化：用象虽弱逢日月生扶无咎；用静不必细详，用动推变化（变生扶吉、变墓绝凶）；用爻有气元神动忌神纵发不须惊；主象休囚元神静忌神动或被月日伐则后必伤躯；用象临旺遇生扶有起死回生之兆

rule.yi: 用象虽然落在弱地，如果遇上日、月来生扶，一定没有灾咎；用象如果安静，不必细究，如果发动，就必须推它的变化，变出生扶就吉，变成墓、绝就凶。歌诀说：用爻有气、元神发动，忌神纵然发动也不必惊慌；主象休囚，又加上被克被破，身体即使暂时没病也会倾覆；用神旺相又遇扶助，病即使到了危险的地步，反而主生。注说：得到用爻旺相、元神又动，日、月即使来伤它，也永远不受克，忌神虽然发动，也不成灾殃；主象如果休囚、元神又静，忌神又正在发动、或者用爻被月建、日辰所伐，身体虽然只是小病，后来一定伤及身躯；用象如果落在旺地又遇生扶，一定有起死回生的征兆。
rule.en: Though the Subject image sits in a weak place, if the Day and Month generate and support it, there is surely no fault; if the Subject is still, there is no need to examine it closely, and if it moves, one must work out its change, a change into generation or support being auspicious and a change into a tomb or Extinction ominous. The verse says: with the Subject line in qi and the Support moving, even if the Adversary moves there is no need for alarm; with the chief image resting or trapped and also controlled and broken, though the body is for the moment unharmed it will still collapse; with the Subject strong and meeting support, though the illness reaches danger it on the contrary means life. The commentary says: if the Subject line is strong and the Support moves too, then even if the Day and Month come to wound it, it is never controlled, and though the Adversary moves, it does no harm; if the chief image is resting or trapped, the Support is still, and the Adversary is moreover moving or the Subject is attacked by the Month or Day, then though the body has only a minor illness, in the end the body will be harmed; if the Subject image is in a strong place and meets generation and support, there is surely a sign of rising from death to life.

zh: 用象虽临弱地，如逢日月生扶，决然无咎。
用如安静，不必细详，用若交重须推变化，变出生扶，则吉；
变成墓绝，则凶。
yi: 用象虽然落在弱地，如果遇上日、月来生扶，一定没有灾咎。
用象如果安静，不必细究；用象如果发动，就必须推它的变化，变出生扶就吉；
变成墓、绝就凶。
en: Though the Subject image sits in a weak place, if the Day and Month generate and support it, there is surely no fault.
If the Subject is still, there is no need to examine it closely; if it moves, one must work out its change, and a change into generation or support is auspicious;
a change into a tomb or Extinction is ominous.

zh: 用爻有气元神动，忌神纵发不须惊。
主象休囚加克破，体虽无恙也遭倾。
用神旺相逢扶助，病纵临危反主生。
yi: 用爻有气、元神发动，忌神纵然发动也不必惊慌；
主象休囚，又加上被克被破，身体即使暂时没病也会倾覆；
用神旺相又遇扶助，病即使到了危险的地步，反而主生。
en: With the Subject line in qi and the Support moving, even if the Adversary moves there is no need for alarm;
with the chief image resting or trapped and also controlled and broken, though the body is for the moment unharmed it will still collapse;
with the Subject strong and meeting support, though the illness reaches danger it on the contrary means life.

zh: 占病，得用爻旺相元神又动，日月纵来相伤永不受克，忌神虽发，亦不为殃。
主象若值休囚，元神又静，忌神况值交重、或被月建日辰伐用，身虽小病，后必伤躯。
用象如临旺地又遇生扶，决有起死回生之兆。
yi: 占病，得到用爻旺相、元神又动，日、月即使来伤它，也永远不受克，忌神虽然发动，也不成灾殃。
主象如果休囚、元神又静，忌神又正在发动、或者用爻被月建、日辰所伐，身体虽然只是小病，后来一定伤及身躯。
用象如果落在旺地又遇生扶，一定有起死回生的征兆。
en: In divining illness, if the Subject line is strong and the Support moves too, then even if the Day and Month come to wound it, it is never controlled, and though the Adversary moves, it does no harm.

If the chief image is resting or trapped, the Support is still, and the Adversary is moreover moving or the Subject is attacked by the Month or Day, then though the body has only a minor illness, in the end the body will be harmed.
If the Subject image is in a strong place and meets generation and support, there is surely a sign of rising from death to life.

note.yi: 这一条和 LY.ILL.EL.08 同出一段，读法是：用象的强弱先看，然后看它动不动；动了看变爻（变生扶吉，变墓绝凶）；再配上元神、忌神。「体虽无恙也遭倾」的「体」是身体。与增删卜易「动墓绝、化墓绝须逢生旺」（LY.ILL.ZS.07）、易冒「用神有一生则生，有一死则死」（LY.ILL.YM.16）是同一件事。
note.en: This entry comes from the same passage as LY.ILL.EL.08 and reads: first the strength of the Subject image, then whether it moves; if it moves, the changed line (a change into generation or support is auspicious, into a tomb or Extinction ominous); and then the Support and the Adversary are set beside it. The 'body' in 'though the body is unharmed it collapses' is the physical body. It is the same matter as the Zengshan Buyi's 'moving into a tomb or Extinction, or changing into one, needs generation or strength' (LY.ILL.ZS.07) and the Yi Mao's 'if the Subject has one generation it lives, if one death it dies' (LY.ILL.YM.16).

units.title: 卦无用象：先察伏神，再推日月，再查互卦；互中体用二爻亦无用神方言无救；主卦无用象而伏出无伤决难损命；伏出遭刑克但日月互卦有一用爻亦无害

rule.yi: 卦里如果没有用象，就要察看伏神，再推日、月；日、月也没有主象、伏神又被刑伤的，再查互卦；互卦里体、用两爻也没有用神的，才说没有救。主卦虽然没有用象，如果伏神出来而没有受伤，一定不会损命；伏神出来即使遭刑克，再远查日、月和互卦之中有一个用爻，也没有害处。
rule.en: If the hexagram has no Subject image, examine the hidden line, and further the Day and Month; if the Day and Month too lack the chief image and the hidden line is wounded by punishment, then examine the nuclear trigrams; only if the body and use lines within the nuclear trigrams also have no Subject can one say there is no rescue. Though the main hexagram has no Subject image, if the hidden line comes out unharmed, life is surely not lost; even if the hidden line, when it comes out, is punished or controlled, if further examination of the Day, Month and nuclear trigrams finds one Subject line, there is no harm.

zh: 卦中如无用象，当察伏神，更推日月，日月又无主象，伏神又被刑伤，再查互卦。
互中体用二爻亦无用神者，方言无救。
主卦虽无用象，倘然伏出无伤，决难损命。
伏出纵遭刑克，远查日月并互卦之中有一用爻，亦无害也。
yi: 卦里如果没有用象，就要察看伏神，再推日、月；日、月也没有主象、伏神又被刑伤的，再查互卦。
互卦里体、用两爻也没有用神的，才说没有救。
主卦虽然没有用象，如果伏神出来而没有受伤，一定不会损命。
伏神出来即使遭刑克，再远查日、月和互卦之中有一个用爻，也没有害处。
en: If the hexagram has no Subject image, examine the hidden line, and further the Day and Month; if the Day and Month too lack the chief image and the hidden line is wounded by punishment, then examine the nuclear trigrams.
Only if the body and use lines within the nuclear trigrams also have no Subject can one say there is no rescue.
Though the main hexagram has no Subject image, if the hidden line comes out unharmed, life is surely not lost.
Even if the hidden line, when it comes out, is punished or controlled, if further examination of the Day, Month and nuclear trigrams finds one Subject line, there is no harm.

dispute.yi: 卦里没有用神先查什么：易林补遗的次序是先察伏神，再推日月，日月也没有主象、伏神又被刑伤，才查互卦，互卦里也没有用神才说无救；增删卜易说日、月作了用神的，不必去找伏神，断他马上就好，伏神衰弱、用神不现，就再占一次（LY.ILL.ZS.14）；易冒说卦无用神，元神动则不死，忌神动而用神伏反吉，也必须得日月来救（LY.ILL.YM.17）；黄金策讲的是用爻不上卦要等它值日露出来（LY.ILL.HJC.39）。几家的次序不同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: What to look at first when the hexagram has no Subject: the Yilin Buyi's order is the hidden line first, then the Day and Month, and only when the Day and Month lack the chief image and the hidden line is punished, the nuclear trigrams, and only if these too have no Subject is there no rescue; the Zengshan Buyi says that if the Day or Month serves as the Subject there is no need to look for the hidden line, and one may promise recovery at once, and that if the hidden line is weak and the Subject does not appear, one divines again (LY.ILL.ZS.14); the Yi Mao says that when the hexagram has no Subject, if the Support moves he does not die, and if the Adversary moves and the Subject is hidden it is on the contrary auspicious, but rescue by the Day and Month is still required (LY.ILL.YM.17); the Huangjin Ce speaks of waiting for a Subject line absent from the hexagram to come out on its day (LY.ILL.HJC.39). The orders differ among the books, and none gives a ruling.

note.yi: 「互卦」是从本卦二、三、四爻和三、四、五爻各取三爻组成的两个卦。「体用二爻」在原文里没有解释；六爻里的「体」「用」在这里疑是指互卦里的「世」和「用神」，读法没有把握。「伏出」是伏神出现（被飞神冲开或生出）。这一条讲的是三层找法：先看伏神（用神不上卦时藏在哪一爻下），再看日、月能不能作用神，再看互卦。
note.en: The 'nuclear trigrams' are the two trigrams formed by taking the second, third and fourth lines and the third, fourth and fifth lines of the hexagram. The 'body and use lines' are not explained in the original; here 'body' and 'use' in the six-line method probably mean the Self and the Subject within the nuclear hexagram, though the reading is uncertain. 'The hidden line comes out' is the hidden line appearing (opened or brought out by the flying line). The entry describes three layers of searching: first the hidden line (under which line the Subject lies when it is absent from the hexagram), then whether the Day or Month can serve as the Subject, then the nuclear trigrams.

units.title: 用爻遇旬空：暴病逢空可救、久病逢空必死；虽空分衰旺——空而旺相久病无妨、空而休囚遇日冲亦不死；立时空又值旬空无不倾亡；不空而月破必伤身

rule.yi: 再说用爻上卦正好遇旬空，要看病是近病还是久病：暴病遇空可救，久病遇空必死。虽然遇空亡，还要分衰旺：空的用爻如果旺相，纵然是久病也没有妨碍；空的用爻如果休囚，只要遇上日冲也不会死。倘若是立时空又遇上旬空，不论近病久病，没有不死的。用爻虽然不落空，如果临月破，必定伤身。
rule.en: Again, when the Subject line is in the hexagram and falls exactly on Void, look at whether the illness is recent or long: a sudden illness meeting Void can be saved, a long illness meeting Void surely dies. Though it meets Void, one still divides strong from weak: if the Void line is strong, even a long illness is no hindrance; if the Void line is resting or trapped, meeting a Day clash it still does not die. If it is Void at the moment and also falls into the ten-day Void, then whether the illness is recent or long, none escapes collapse. Though the Subject line is not Void, if it sits in Month-break it will surely harm the body.

zh: 又论用爻上卦正值旬空，却看病之远近，暴病逢空可救，久病逢空必死。
虽值空亡，还分衰旺。
空如旺相，纵然久病也无妨。
空若休囚，但遇日冲亦不死。
倘若立时空又值旬空，不拘远近之病，无不倾亡。
用爻虽不落空，如临月破必致伤身。
yi: 再说用爻上卦正好遇旬空，要看病是近病还是久病：暴病遇空可救，久病遇空必死。
虽然遇空亡，还要分衰旺。
空的用爻如果旺相，纵然是久病也没有妨碍。
空的用爻如果休囚，只要遇上日冲也不会死。
倘若是立时空又遇上旬空，不论近病久病，没有不死的。
用爻虽然不落空，如果临月破，必定伤身。
en: Again, when the Subject line is in the hexagram and falls exactly on Void, look at whether the illness is recent or long: a sudden illness meeting Void can be saved, a long illness meeting Void surely dies.
Though it meets Void, one still divides strong from weak.
If the Void line is strong, even a long illness is no hindrance.
If the Void line is resting or trapped, meeting a Day clash it still does not die.
If it is Void at the moment and also falls into the ten-day Void, then whether the illness is recent or long, none escapes collapse.
Though the Subject line is not Void, if it sits in Month-break it will surely harm the body.

dispute.yi: 用神落空要不要分近病久病：易林补遗分：暴病逢空可救、久病逢空必死，而且空了还要分衰旺——旺相的久病也无妨，休囚的遇日冲也不死；增删卜易的野鹤同样分近久，近病落空到冲空、实空的日子就好，久病用神落旬空月破则旺相也无法治（LY.ILL.ZS.04、ZS.05）；黄金策旧注和《海底眼》说主象落空占病大忌，要有动爻日辰冲克才有救，不分近久（LY.ILL.HJC.37）。易林补遗的「空旺相久病也无妨」和增删卜易的「久病用神空破，旺相也无法医治」在久病旺相的空爻上说法相反。
dispute.en: Whether a Void Subject calls for a division between recent and long illness: the Yilin Buyi divides them: a sudden illness meeting Void can be saved and a long one surely dies, and beyond that a Void line is divided by strength — a strong one is no hindrance even in a long illness, a resting or trapped one does not die if it meets a Day clash; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi likewise divides recent from long, a recent illness with the Subject Void being well on the day the Void is clashed or filled, while for a long illness a Subject that is Void or in Month-break cannot be treated even if strong (LY.ILL.ZS.04, ZS.05); the old commentary on the Huangjin Ce and the Haidi Yan say that a Void chief image is a great taboo in divining illness and that a moving line or a clash or control by the Day is needed for rescue, without dividing recent from long (LY.ILL.HJC.37). On a strong Void line in a long illness the Yilin Buyi ('strong Void, even a long illness is no hindrance') and the Zengshan Buyi ('long illness, Subject Void or broken, even strong it cannot be treated') say opposite things.

note.yi: 「立时空」原文没有解释，大概指当下、此时就落空（与旬空的空相对），读法没有把握，这里按字面译作「立时空」。「日冲」是日辰冲它：冲空则实。这一条在「暴病逢空可救、久病逢空必死」上与增删卜易同，与黄金策旧注不同；但在空而旺相的久病是否无妨上，与增删卜易相反（见上面的分歧）。
note.en: 'Void at the moment' (li shi kong) is not explained in the original; it probably means Void right now, as against the Void of the ten-day cycle, but the reading is uncertain and it is translated literally. A 'Day clash' is the Day clashing it: a clash fills a Void. This entry agrees with the Zengshan Buyi on 'a sudden illness meeting Void can be saved and a long illness surely dies' and differs from the old commentary on the Huangjin Ce, but on whether a strong Void line makes a long illness harmless it is opposed to the Zengshan Buyi (see the disagreement above).

units.title: 忌变生而用变克，分毫之疾恐伤刑；用之旺者忌之绝，沉重之灾即刻轻：疾病卦中忌神旺动又变生扶、主象衰摇化成死绝、元神克破则无救；用神居衰位而化出帝旺长生、忌神动化克伤死绝之乡则旦夕可安

rule.yi: 忌神变生、用神变克，一丝一毫的病也恐怕要伤刑；用神旺、忌神绝，沉重的灾也立刻转轻。像这样断定，可以留传万古，何须再到海外去求明白。注说：疾病卦里，忌神旺又发动、又变出生扶，主象衰弱摇动、变成死绝，元神又被克破，怎么还有救？用神即使居于衰位，如果化出帝旺、长生，又遇上扶助，忌神虽然发动而变成克伤死绝之乡，不能制用神，病虽然沉重，旦夕可以安好，这样推没有差错。
rule.en: If the Adversary changes into generation and the Subject changes into control, even the slightest ailment may bring harm; if the Subject is strong and the Adversary in Extinction, a heavy calamity lightens at once. What is decided thus can be handed down for ten thousand ages; why then seek clarity overseas? The commentary says: in an illness hexagram, if the Adversary is strong and moving and also changes into generation and support, the chief image is weak and swaying and changes into death or Extinction, and the Support is controlled and broken, how could there be rescue? Though the Subject sits in a weak place, if it changes into Peak or Birth and meets support, then although the Adversary moves and changes into a place of control, wounding, death or Extinction and cannot restrain the Subject, the illness, however heavy, may be at ease by morning or night, and there is no error in reckoning so.

zh: 忌变生而用变克，分毫之疾恐伤刑，
用之旺者忌之绝，沉重之灾即刻轻，
如此定之留万古，何须海外再求明。
yi: 忌神变生、用神变克，一丝一毫的病也恐怕要伤刑，
用神旺、忌神绝，沉重的灾也立刻转轻。
像这样断定，可以留传万古，何须再到海外去求明白。
en: If the Adversary changes into generation and the Subject changes into control, even the slightest ailment may bring harm;
if the Subject is strong and the Adversary in Extinction, a heavy calamity lightens at once.
What is decided thus can be handed down for ten thousand ages; why then seek clarity overseas?

zh: 疾病卦中忌神旺动又变生扶，主象衰摇化成死绝，元神又之克破，岂有救哉？
用神虽居衰位，化出帝旺长生，又逢扶助忌神虽动而化为克伤死绝之乡，不能制用，病虽沉重，旦夕可安，如此推之并无差谬。
yi: 疾病卦里，忌神旺又发动、又变出生扶，主象衰弱摇动、变成死绝，元神又被克破，怎么还有救？
用神即使居于衰位，如果化出帝旺、长生，又遇上扶助，忌神虽然发动而变成克伤死绝之乡，不能制用神，病虽然沉重，旦夕可以安好，这样推没有差错。
en: In an illness hexagram, if the Adversary is strong and moving and also changes into generation and support, the chief image is weak and swaying and changes into death or Extinction, and the Support is controlled and broken, how could there be rescue?

Though the Subject sits in a weak place, if it changes into Peak or Birth and meets support, then although the Adversary moves and changes into a place of control, wounding, death or Extinction and cannot restrain the Subject, the illness, however heavy, may be at ease by morning or night, and there is no error in reckoning so.

note.yi: 这一条的歌诀是把上两条（LY.ILL.EL.08、EL.09）里「变」的部分单拿出来说：忌神和用神各自的变化方向，比它们当下的强弱更要紧——忌神变生、用神变克是凶，用神旺忌神绝是吉。「刑」是刑伤。「何须海外再求明」指不必到别处去求更高明的说法，这一套已经够了。歌诀的后四句（卦名、神煞、空身空命、无鬼无财）放在下面 LY.ILL.EL.13、EL.14。「帝旺、长生」是十二长生里的旺位和生位。
note.en: The verse takes up the 'change' part of the last two entries (LY.ILL.EL.08, EL.09): the direction of change of the Adversary and the Subject matters more than their present strength — the Adversary changing into generation and the Subject into control is ominous, the Subject strong and the Adversary in Extinction auspicious. 'Harm' is punishment or injury. 'Why then seek clarity overseas' means there is no need to look elsewhere for a higher teaching, since this suffices. The last four lines of the verse (hexagram names, spirit-stars, Void of body and natal branch, no ghost and no Wealth) are placed below in LY.ILL.EL.13 and EL.14. 'Peak' and 'Birth' are the strong and generating stages of the twelve life stages.

units.title: 休把卦名推祸福，莫将神煞决忧祯：其中有论卦名者切不可；论神煞者亦非；用神旺则墓门煞大煞动亦不死、用神既伤则月解天医同发亦死；五行为重，神煞难凭，星家专忌本命空亡非正道

rule.yi: 不要用卦名去推祸福，不要拿神煞去断忧祯。注说：其中有拿卦名来论的，切不可；经里说，易卦的渊源是论五行阴阳的道理，本来生生不息，可怜愚昧无知的人颠倒阴阳去论卦名，如今有人拿神煞来论的也不对；经里又说，易卦阴阳在变通，五行生克妙无穷，现在的人不明白阴阳的道理，拿神煞来定吉凶。比如儿子占父亲的病，父爻旺相，墓门煞或大煞又动，用爻有气，怎么会死？又如丈夫占妻子的病，财爻无气，父爻兄弟爻都动，纵然月解、天医同时发动，用爻既然受了伤，怎么能不推断为死？所以以五行为重，神煞难以凭信，星家专门忌讳本命空亡，这不是正道。
rule.en: Do not push fortune and misfortune by the names of hexagrams, and do not decide grief and omen by spirit-stars. The commentary says: those who judge by hexagram names must on no account be followed; the classic says the source of the Yi hexagrams is to judge by the principles of the five phases and yin and yang, which by nature give birth without end, and pitiable ignorant people turn yin and yang upside down and judge by hexagram names, and those who now judge by spirit-stars are also wrong; the classic says again that in the hexagrams yin and yang lie in change, and the generation and control of the five phases are marvellous without end, but people now do not understand the principle of yin and yang and use the spirit-stars to fix fortune. For example, if a son divines a father's illness and the Resource line is strong, and the Tomb Gate star or the Great Killing also moves, the Subject line having qi, how could he die? Again, if a husband divines a wife's illness and the Wealth line has no qi, and the Resource and Peer lines both move, even if Month Release and Heavenly Doctor move together, the Subject being already wounded, how can one judge otherwise than death? Therefore the five phases are weighty and the spirit-stars hard to rely on, and that astrologers particularly fear the Void of the natal branch is not the right way.

zh: 休把卦名推祸福，莫将神煞决忧祯，
yi: 不要用卦名去推祸福，不要拿神煞去断忧祯，
en: Do not push fortune and misfortune by the names of hexagrams, and do not decide grief and omen by spirit-stars;

zh: 其中有论卦名者，切不可也。
经云易卦渊源论五行阴阳之理，本生生可怜愚昧无知识颠倒阴阳论卦名，今有人论神煞者亦非也。
经云易卦阴阳在变通五行生克妙无穷，时人不辨阴阳理，神煞将来定吉凶。
假令子占父病，父爻旺相，墓门煞或大煞又动，用爻有气，岂能死乎？
又如夫占妻病，财爻无气父兄皆动，纵得月解天医同发，用既遭伤，岂不死推？
故此五行为重，神煞难凭，星家专忌本命空亡，此非正道。
yi: 其中有拿卦名来论的，切不可。
经里说，易卦的渊源是论五行阴阳的道理，本来生生不息，可怜愚昧无知的人颠倒阴阳去论卦名，如今有人拿神煞来论的也不对。
经里又说，易卦阴阳在变通，五行生克妙无穷，现在的人不明白阴阳的道理，拿神煞来定吉凶。
比如儿子占父亲的病，父爻旺相，墓门煞或大煞又动，用爻有气，怎么会死？
又如丈夫占妻子的病，财爻无气，父爻、兄弟爻都动，纵然月解、天医同时发动，用爻既然受了伤，怎么能不推断为死？
所以以五行为重，神煞难以凭信，星家专门忌讳本命空亡，这不是正道。
en: Those who judge by hexagram names must on no account be followed.

The classic says the source of the Yi hexagrams is to judge by the principles of the five phases and yin and yang, which by nature give birth without end, and pitiable ignorant people turn yin and yang upside down and judge by hexagram names, and those who now judge by spirit-stars are also wrong.

The classic says again that in the hexagrams yin and yang lie in change, and the generation and control of the five phases are marvellous without end, but people now do not understand the principle of yin and yang and use the spirit-stars to fix fortune.
For example, if a son divines a father's illness and the Resource line is strong, and the Tomb Gate star or the Great Killing also moves, the Subject line having qi, how could he die?

Again, if a husband divines a wife's illness and the Wealth line has no qi, and the Resource and Peer lines both move, even if Month Release and Heavenly Doctor move together, the Subject being already wounded, how can one judge otherwise than death?
Therefore the five phases are weighty and the spirit-stars hard to rely on, and that astrologers particularly fear the Void of the natal branch is not the right way.

dispute.yi: 卦名、神煞能不能断病的生死：易林补遗说五行为重、神煞难凭，卦名不可论，星家专忌本命空亡不是正道；增删卜易的野鹤同样说卦名、卦身世身兼用、本命丧门、蛇虎星煞都不验，只看用神，只有卦变六冲例外（LY.ILL.ZS.01）；易冒也说四灭没、十卦、凶煞皆不死，神煞尤轻（LY.ILL.YM.11）；易隐则把黄泉杀、四灭卦、四没卦、棺椁杀列为占病逢之必死，又把三坵五墓、丧门吊客、死符丧车等列为动而临用必死的凶煞（LY.ILL.YY.05、YY.08）。前三家一边，易隐一边。
dispute.en: Whether hexagram names and spirit-stars can judge life and death in illness: the Yilin Buyi says the five phases weigh most and the spirit-stars are hard to rely on, that hexagram names cannot be used, and that astrologers' special fear of the Void of the natal branch is not the right way; the Old Man of Yehe in the Zengshan Buyi likewise says that hexagram names, using the Body and Self together, the mourning stars on the natal branch, and the Snake and Tiger stars are all unproved, that only the Subject is looked at, with the Six-Clash changing into Six-Clash the one exception (LY.ILL.ZS.01); the Yi Mao also says the Four Extinguishing and Submerging, the ten hexagrams and the malign stars do not mean death, and that spirit-stars weigh lighter still (LY.ILL.YM.11); the Yi Yin, on the other hand, lists the Yellow Springs, the Four Extinguishing, the Four Submerging and the Coffin killers as hexagrams that mean death for one who divines illness, and lists Three Mounds and Five Tombs, Mourning Gate and Guest of Condolence, Death Tally and Funeral Carriage and the like as malign stars that mean death when they move and sit on the Subject (LY.ILL.YY.05, YY.08). The first three stand on one side and the Yi Yin on the other.

note.yi: 这一段的两个「经云」是评注者引用的，原文没有说明出自哪部经，这里照录、没有指认出处。「墓门煞」「大煞」「月解」「天医」都是神煞名（月解、天医是吉神，墓门煞、大煞是凶煞）。评注者用两个反例把「神煞能救」「神煞能杀」都打掉：用爻有气，凶煞动也不死；用爻受伤，吉神动也死。「星家」指按命理星命来断的人。
note.en: The two 'the classic says' in this passage are quoted by the commentator, and the original does not say from which classic; they are copied as they stand and no source is asserted. 'Tomb Gate', 'Great Killing', 'Month Release' and 'Heavenly Doctor' are names of spirit-stars (Month Release and Heavenly Doctor being auspicious, Tomb Gate and Great Killing malign). The commentator uses two counter-examples to knock down both 'a spirit-star can save' and 'a spirit-star can kill': with the Subject line in qi a malign star moving does not kill, and with the Subject wounded an auspicious star moving does not save. 'Astrologers' are those who judge by the astrology of fate.

units.title: 空身空命皆非忌，无鬼无财岂足凭：甲子旬空戌亥不等于属猪属犬人皆命绝；病人无鬼必死之说不准，无鬼不过无神祟；无财只是眼下不思饮食，惟夫占妻、主占仆忌财空

rule.yi: 空身、空命都不必忌讳，无鬼、无财哪里够得上凭据。注说：比如甲子旬占，空的是戌、亥，天下万万属猪、属狗的人，难道都命绝了？前人又说病人无鬼必死，难道没有验证过吗？《天玄赋》里虽然说占病无鬼，就没有叩告的门路，是天年命尽，这病不能好。可是比如哥哥占弟弟的病，鬼是忌神，怎么该在卦里？又如父亲占儿子的病，鬼是仇人，怎么可以用它？如果按道理论病，只取用爻的旺衰生克，就能断定存亡。凡是卦里无鬼，不过是没有神祟罢了，难道就是天年命尽？何况现在屡次试验没有官鬼的卦，也未必死。又辨别没有财的说法更加差错：财爻虽然是饮食，没有财，不过是眼下不吃东西，怎么能丧命？只有丈夫占妻子、主人占仆人来看，才忌讳财空，其余占的都不忌讳。
rule.en: The Void of the Body and the Void of the natal branch need not be feared, and no ghost or no Wealth is hardly enough to rely on. The commentary says: for example, when a divination is made in the Jiazi decade the Void branches are Xu and Hai, and of the innumerable people under heaven born in the year of the pig or the dog, are all to have their lives cut off? The men of old also said that a patient with no ghost must die, and was there no proof? Although the Tianxuan Fu says that in divining illness with no ghost there is no door to knock on and appeal, it is the end of one's allotted years, and the illness will not be cured. But for instance, if an elder brother divines a younger brother's illness, the ghost is the Adversary, and how should it be in the hexagram? Or if a father divines a son's illness, the ghost is an enemy, and how can it be used? If the illness is discussed on principle, only the strength and the generation and control of the Subject line are taken, and life or death is decided. A hexagram with no ghost only lacks a haunting, and is it therefore the end of one's allotted years? Moreover, no-Official hexagrams have been tried many times and the person did not necessarily die. Again the claim about lacking Wealth is even more mistaken: though the Wealth line is food and drink, lacking it only means that for the moment he does not eat, how can that cost his life? Only in a husband divining a wife or a master a servant is a Void Wealth line feared, and in all other divinations it is not feared.

zh: 空身空命皆非忌，无鬼无财岂足凭。
yi: 空身、空命都不必忌讳，无鬼、无财哪里够得上凭据。
en: The Void of the Body and the Void of the natal branch need not be feared, and no ghost or no Wealth is hardly enough to rely on.

zh: 且如甲子旬占，空当戌亥，寰中万万属猪属犬生人，岂皆命绝？
前人又言病人无鬼必死，岂无验乎？
天玄赋中虽曰占病无鬼必无叩告之门，乃天年命尽也，其病不瘳。
且如兄占弟病，鬼乃忌神，岂宜在卦？
又如父占子病，鬼作仇人，焉可用之？
若据理上论病只取用爻旺衰生克，便决存亡。
凡卦无鬼不过无神祟耳，岂就作天年命尽乎？
况今屡试无官之卦，未必死也。
又辨无财者理更差误，财爻虽为饮食，无者不过目今饮食不食，焉能丧命？
只有夫占妻、主占仆看，惟忌财空，其余占者皆不忌。
yi: 比如甲子旬占，空的是戌、亥，天下万万属猪、属狗的人，难道都命绝了？
前人又说病人无鬼必死，难道没有验证过吗？
《天玄赋》里虽然说占病无鬼，就没有叩告的门路，是天年命尽，这病不能好。
可是比如哥哥占弟弟的病，鬼是忌神，怎么该在卦里？
又如父亲占儿子的病，鬼是仇人，怎么可以用它？
如果按道理论病，只取用爻的旺衰生克，就能断定存亡。
凡是卦里无鬼，不过是没有神祟罢了，难道就是天年命尽？
何况现在屡次试验没有官鬼的卦，也未必死。
又辨别没有财的说法更加差错：财爻虽然是饮食，没有财，不过是眼下不吃东西，怎么能丧命？
只有丈夫占妻子、主人占仆人来看，才忌讳财空，其余占的都不忌讳。
en: For example, when a divination is made in the Jiazi decade the Void branches are Xu and Hai, and of the innumerable people under heaven born in the year of the pig or the dog, are all to have their lives cut off?
The men of old also said that a patient with no ghost must die, and was there no proof?
Although the Tianxuan Fu says that in divining illness with no ghost there is no door to knock on and appeal, it is the end of one's allotted years, and the illness will not be cured.
But for instance, if an elder brother divines a younger brother's illness, the ghost is the Adversary, and how should it be in the hexagram?
Or if a father divines a son's illness, the ghost is an enemy, and how can it be used?
If the illness is discussed on principle, only the strength and the generation and control of the Subject line are taken, and life or death is decided.
A hexagram with no ghost only lacks a haunting, and is it therefore the end of one's allotted years?
Moreover, hexagrams without a Pressure line have been tried many times and the person did not necessarily die.
Again the claim about lacking Wealth is even more mistaken: though the Wealth line is food and drink, lacking it only means that for the moment he does not eat, how can that cost his life?
Only in a husband divining a wife or a master a servant is a Void Wealth line feared, and in all other divinations it is not feared.

dispute.yi: 病人卦里无鬼、无财是不是必死：易林补遗说无鬼不过是没有神祟，不等于天年命尽；无财不过眼下不思饮食，只有夫占妻、主占仆才忌财空；它批评的是《天玄赋》的「占病无鬼必无叩告之门，乃天年命尽」；易冒同样说无鬼无财、身空命空皆不死（LY.ILL.YM.11）；黄金策却说官鬼虽是恶煞不可无，不上卦要寻伏，伏又空则病必不能痊（LY.ILL.HJC.49），黄金策旧注、王洪绪对这句的范围也不一致；易隐里晁以道说用爻、命爻不上卦者死，男忌鬼空、女忌财空（LY.ILL.YY.10）；黄金策又说禄系妻财、寿属父母，财空无财则不思饮食（LY.ILL.HJC.38）。几家说法不同，书里没有裁决。
dispute.en: Whether a patient's hexagram with no ghost or no Wealth means certain death: the Yilin Buyi says no ghost only lacks a haunting and does not mean the end of one's allotted years, and no Wealth only means he does not want to eat for the moment, a Void Wealth line being feared only in a husband divining a wife or a master a servant; what it criticises is the Tianxuan Fu's 'in divining illness with no ghost there is no door to knock on, it is the end of one's allotted years'; the Yi Mao likewise says that no ghost and no Wealth, Void of the Body or of the natal branch, do not mean death (LY.ILL.YM.11); the Huangjin Ce, however, says that although the Pressure line is a malign killer it cannot be absent, that when it is absent from the hexagram one must look for it hidden, and that if the hidden one is also Void the illness cannot be cured (LY.ILL.HJC.49), and the old commentary and Wang Hongxu differ on the scope of that saying; in the Yi Yin, Chao Yidao says that one whose Subject line or natal-branch line is absent from the hexagram dies, and that men fear Void ghosts and women Void Wealth (LY.ILL.YY.10); the Huangjin Ce also says that emolument belongs to Wealth and long life to the Resource line, and that a Void or absent Wealth means no appetite (LY.ILL.HJC.38). The books differ, and none gives a ruling.

note.yi: 这一条把上一条歌诀的最后两句「空身空命皆非忌，无鬼无财岂足凭」拿出来单讲：空命（本命落旬空）、无鬼（卦无官鬼）、无财（卦无妻财）三种说法，评注者一个一个驳。「叩告之门」是可以向鬼神叩告的门路，出自《天玄赋》所说的「占病无鬼必无叩告之门」（黄金策也用了这句，见 LY.ILL.HJC.49）。「兄占弟病，鬼乃忌神」是说占兄弟的病，用神是兄弟，官鬼克兄弟，所以是忌神；「父占子病，鬼作仇人」是说占子孙的病，子孙的仇神是官鬼——所以这些卦里官鬼不该出现，何必因为无鬼就断死。
note.en: This entry takes the last two lines of the verse in the last entry, 'the Void of the Body and of the natal branch need not be feared, no ghost or no Wealth is hardly enough to rely on', and discusses them separately: three sayings, Void natal branch (the natal branch falling on the ten-day Void), no ghost (the hexagram lacks a Pressure line) and no Wealth (it lacks a Wealth line), and the commentator refutes them one by one. The 'door to knock on and appeal' is the way of appealing to ghosts and spirits, from the Tianxuan Fu's 'in divining illness with no ghost there is no door to knock on' (the Huangjin Ce uses this sentence too; see LY.ILL.HJC.49). 'An elder brother divining a younger brother's illness, the ghost is the Adversary' means that in divining a brother's illness the Subject is the Peer line, and the Pressure line controls the Peer, so it is the Adversary; 'a father divining a son's illness, the ghost is an enemy' means that for a son's illness the enemy of Output is the Pressure line; so in such hexagrams the Pressure line ought not to appear, and there is no reason to judge death because the ghost is absent.

units.chapter: 疾病用神(章题缺,在是病非病之后)
units.chapter_en: The Subject in illness (chapter title missing; after the passage on real illness)
units.title: 六冲分缓急：初灾遇六冲当全瘥、久病逢之命必伤，合处逢冲同此意，不凭主象弱和强；土爻临鬼动多凶少吉；近病逢冲则愈、重病逢冲则死；占尊长鬼为元神动则祈让可疗

rule.yi: 只有六冲这一种，能分缓急，病的来源要自己斟酌衡量：刚起的灾遇上它应当全好，久病遇上它命必伤；合处逢冲也是这个意思，不看主象是弱还是强；再看土爻临鬼发动，凶多吉少，灾祸难以禳解。注说：病得六冲、六冲变冲、合处逢冲，都要审察病是远是近、是轻是重：暴病来占，朝夕之间就应当痊愈；如果久病来占，用象虽然旺相，也主身亡。又说近病逢冲就好，重病逢冲就死；卦纵然不冲，用爻也旺，凡是遇上财爻、鬼爻发动的，都可以断死；只有占尊长，鬼是元神，发动了就祈祷禳解可以治疗。
rule.en: Only the Six-Clash tells slow from urgent, and the source of the illness must be weighed by oneself: a fresh calamity meeting it should be wholly cured, a long illness meeting it surely brings harm to life; a clash met in a combination has the same meaning, without regard to whether the chief image is weak or strong; and further, an Earth line on a moving ghost is mostly ominous and seldom auspicious, and the misfortune is hard to exorcise. The commentary says: when an illness has a six-clash, or a six-clash changing into a clash, or a clash met in a combination, one must examine whether it is near or far, light or heavy: a sudden illness divined should be cured by morning or evening; if a long illness is divined, though the Subject image is strong it still means death. It says also that a recent illness meeting a clash is cured and a heavy illness meeting a clash dies; even if the hexagram is not clashing and the Subject line is strong, wherever the Wealth or Pressure line moves one may say death; only in divining an elder, the ghost being the Support, moving it can be treated by prayer and exorcism.

zh: 又云惟有六冲分缓急，病源却要自斟量，
初灾遇此当全瘥，久病逢之命必伤，
合处逢冲同此意，不凭主象弱和强，
更论土爻临鬼动，爻凶少吉祸难禳。
yi: 只有六冲这一种，能分缓急，病的来源要自己斟酌衡量，
刚起的灾遇上它应当全好，久病遇上它命必伤，
合处逢冲也是这个意思，不看主象是弱还是强，
再看土爻临鬼发动，凶多吉少，灾祸难以禳解。
en: Only the Six-Clash tells slow from urgent, and the source of the illness must be weighed by oneself:
a fresh calamity meeting it should be wholly cured, a long illness meeting it surely brings harm to life;
a clash met in a combination has the same meaning, without regard to whether the chief image is weak or strong;
and further, an Earth line on a moving ghost is mostly ominous and seldom auspicious, and the misfortune is hard to exorcise.

zh: 病得六冲化冲、合处逢冲，皆要审其远近重轻，如暴病来占，朝夕即当痊愈。
若久病占之，用象虽然旺相，也主身亡。
又论近病逢冲则愈，重病逢冲则死。
卦纵不冲，用爻亦旺，凡遇财鬼动者，万可言死。
惟占尊长，鬼为元神，动则祈让可疗。
yi: 病得六冲、六冲变冲、合处逢冲，都要审察病是远是近、是轻是重：暴病来占，朝夕之间就应当痊愈。
如果久病来占，用象虽然旺相，也主身亡。
又说近病逢冲就好，重病逢冲就死。
卦纵然不冲，用爻也旺，凡是遇上财爻、鬼爻发动的，都可以断死。
只有占尊长，鬼是元神，发动了就祈祷禳解可以治疗。
en: When an illness has a six-clash, or a six-clash changing into a clash, or a clash met in a combination, one must examine whether it is near or far, light or heavy: a sudden illness divined should be cured by morning or evening.
If a long illness is divined, though the Subject image is strong it still means death.
It says also that a recent illness meeting a clash is cured and a heavy illness meeting a clash dies.
Even if the hexagram is not clashing and the Subject line is strong, wherever the Wealth or Pressure line moves one may say death.
Only in divining an elder, the ghost being the Support, moving it can be treated by prayer and exorcism.

note.yi: 原文「初灾遇此当全瘥」中的「瘥」是病愈；歌诀最后一句「爻凶少吉祸难禳」里的「爻凶」疑是「多凶」之误（注解处写作「多凶少吉」），这里按上下文译作「凶多吉少」。「六冲、六冲变冲、合处逢冲」是三种冲：卦是六冲卦、六冲卦变六冲卦、六合卦（或合爻）遇冲。这一条与增删卜易「六冲变冲久病难于调治」（LY.ILL.ZS.02）、「卦变绝克新疾亦主危亡」（LY.ILL.ZS.03）、易冒「卦属反伏墓绝亦不治；病未久三冲而愈、病已久三冲而亡」（LY.ILL.YM.10）、易隐（LY.ILL.YY.07）是同一件事，各家对久病遇冲的结论一致：久病逢冲必死；对近病遇冲则略有出入（此处近病逢冲则愈）。
note.en: 'Cured' (jiu) in 'a fresh calamity meeting it should be wholly cured' is recovery from illness; the 'yao xiong' (line ominous) in the last line of the verse looks like an error for 'duo xiong' (mostly ominous), which the commentary writes as 'mostly ominous and seldom auspicious', and it is translated so from the context. 'A six-clash, a six-clash changing into a clash, a clash met in a combination' are three kinds of clash: the hexagram being a Six-Clash hexagram, a Six-Clash hexagram changing into another, and a Six-Combine hexagram (or a combining line) meeting a clash. It is the same matter as the Zengshan Buyi's 'a Six-Clash changing into a clash makes a long illness hard to treat' (LY.ILL.ZS.02) and 'a change into Extinction or control also means danger in a fresh illness' (LY.ILL.ZS.03), the Yi Mao's 'a hexagram that is Reversed, Hidden, in a tomb or in Extinction is untreatable; a recent illness is cured by the three clashes, a long one dies' (LY.ILL.YM.10) and the Yi Yin (LY.ILL.YY.07); the books agree that a long illness meeting a clash surely dies, and differ slightly on a recent illness meeting a clash (here it is cured).

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 疾病生克论之一：百病重轻不出五行生死，万民生死难逃八卦兴衰——以水、火、土、金为主象各举其所畏所喜（水畏土喜金木、火土皆动见木反凶，土为用神水木火三动当从吉断……），查何日逢金便决何时作殡

rule.yi: 百病的轻重，不出五行的生死；万民的生死，逃不出八卦的兴衰。注举了用神为水、为金、为土、为火的几种情形，一一说明畏什么、喜什么：水是主象，怕土，也怕金以外的受制；卦里土静火兴，不必畏忌；爻内火安静、土动，却不吉祥；怕遇上巳、午两个时辰，喜遇上木、金；又如火土都动，见木反而凶，得到酉、申来助水，这病才会痊愈。假如金藏在土下，飞神能生伏神就好；木爻安静，日辰忌卯、寅，木象发动，时辰忧亥、子，这就是所说的遇金则吉、遇水则凶。再拿土作用神，卦里见水、木、火三个爻同时发动，不当作凶来推，应当按吉断；遇午、申的时候，土得到生扶就吉，逢卯、巳的日子，土临死绝就被囚。又论火是用爻，只有水发动的日子遇上戌、辰、丑、未，水被土克无妨；一见酉、申就命尽，只求寅、卯就身安。如果用爻居于衰位、木化入金乡，卦里没有亥、子和父爻兴旺，一定难以救度，查哪一天逢金，就断哪个时候办丧事；倘若金空，就不这样断，节气产到亥、子，命也会回生，细究哪个爻动静，就知道哪天存亡。其中有贪生忘克、救处遭伤，盈虚要精细详审，怎么可以寻常一概而论？
rule.en: The lightness or heaviness of a hundred illnesses does not go beyond the birth and death of the five phases; the life and death of the people of ten thousand houses cannot escape the rise and fall of the eight trigrams. The commentary gives cases with the Subject as Water, Metal, Earth and Fire, and says of each what it fears and what it welcomes: with Water as the chief image, it fears Earth; if in the hexagram Earth is still and Fire thriving there is no need to fear it; if in the lines Fire is still and Earth moves, it is not auspicious; it fears meeting the hours Si and Wu, and is glad to meet Wood and Metal; again, if Fire and Earth both move, meeting Wood is on the contrary ominous, and when You and Shen come to help Water the illness will be cured. If Metal lies hidden under Earth, it is good if the flying line can generate the hidden one; if the Wood line is still, the Mao and Yin days are to be feared, and if the Wood image moves, the Hai and Zi hours are a worry: this is what is meant by 'meeting Metal is auspicious, meeting Water ominous'. Taking Earth again as the Subject, if the hexagram shows Water, Wood and Fire lines all three moving, do not judge it ominous but by the auspicious; at the hours Wu and Shen Earth gains generation and support and it is auspicious, and on Mao and Si days Earth on death or Extinction is imprisoned. Again, with Fire as the Subject line, when only Water moves on a day that meets Xu, Chen, Chou or Wei, Water is controlled by Earth and it does not matter; at the first sight of You or Shen life is at an end, and only if one hopes for Yin or Mao is the body safe. If the Subject line sits in a weak place and Wood changes into Metal's country, and the hexagram has no Hai or Zi or a thriving Resource line, rescue is hard, and to find on what day it meets Metal is to decide at what time the coffin is made; if Metal is Void, it is not judged so, and when the solar term reaches Hai and Zi life is restored, and if one examines which line moves and which is still, one knows on which day one lives or dies. Among these are those who, greedy for generation, forget control, or are harmed at the place of rescue, and fullness and emptiness must be examined finely: how can they be judged by the common general rule?

zh: 百病重轻，不出五行生死；
万民生死，难逃八卦兴衰。
yi: 百病的轻重，不出五行的生死；
万民的生死，逃不出八卦的兴衰。
en: The lightness or heaviness of a hundred illnesses does not go beyond the birth and death of the five phases;
the life and death of the people of ten thousand houses cannot escape the rise and fall of the eight trigrams.

zh: 且如水为主象，畏土纵金；
卦中土静火兴，不须畏忌。
爻内火安土动，却不为祥。
怕逢巳午二时喜遇木金二字。
又如火土皆动，见木反凶，得酉申而助水疑此病以方痊。
假令金藏土下，飞能生伏为佳，如木爻安静日忌卯寅，若木象交重时忧亥子，正所谓逢金则吉，遇水则凶。
复将土作用神，卦见水木火爻三动，不作凶推，当从吉断。
时遇午申，土得生扶则吉，日逢卯巳，土临死绝则囚。
又论火是用爻，独逢水发日遇戌辰丑未，水遭土克无妨，一见酉申当命尽，但求寅卯必身安。
若用居衰木化入金乡，卦无亥子父兴，必难救度，查何日逢金，便决何时作殡。
倘若金空亦非此断，节产亥子，命亦回生，细究何爻动静，便知那日存亡。
其中有贪生忘克，救处遭伤、盈虚却要精详，岂可寻常概论？
yi: 比如水是主象，怕土，也纵金；
卦里土静火兴，不必畏忌。
爻内火安静、土动，却不吉祥。
怕遇上巳、午两个时辰，喜欢遇上木、金两个字。
又如火、土都动，见木反而凶，得到酉、申来助水，这病才会痊愈。
假如金藏在土下，飞神能生伏神就好；木爻安静，日辰忌卯、寅，木象发动，时辰忧亥、子，这就是所说的遇金则吉、遇水则凶。
再拿土作用神，卦里见水、木、火三个爻同时发动，不当作凶来推，应当按吉断；
遇午、申的时候，土得到生扶就吉，逢卯、巳的日子，土临死绝就被囚。
又论火是用爻，只有水发动的日子遇上戌、辰、丑、未，水被土克无妨；一见酉、申就命尽，只求寅、卯就身安。
如果用爻居于衰位、木化入金乡，卦里没有亥、子和父爻兴旺，一定难以救度，查哪一天逢金，就断哪个时候办丧事。
倘若金空，就不这样断，节气产到亥、子，命也会回生，细究哪个爻动静，就知道哪天存亡。
其中有贪生忘克、救处遭伤，盈虚要精细详审，怎么可以寻常一概而论？
en: For example, with Water as the chief image, it fears Earth and lets Metal be;
if in the hexagram Earth is still and Fire thriving, there is no need to fear it.
If in the lines Fire is still and Earth moves, it is not auspicious.
It fears meeting the two hours Si and Wu, and is glad to meet the two, Wood and Metal.
Again, if Fire and Earth both move, meeting Wood is on the contrary ominous, and when You and Shen come to help Water the illness will be cured.

If Metal lies hidden under Earth, it is good if the flying line can generate the hidden one; if the Wood line is still, the Mao and Yin days are to be feared, and if the Wood image moves, the Hai and Zi hours are a worry: this is what is meant by 'meeting Metal is auspicious, meeting Water ominous'.
Taking Earth again as the Subject, if the hexagram shows Water, Wood and Fire lines all three moving, do not judge it ominous but by the auspicious;
at the hours Wu and Shen Earth gains generation and support and it is auspicious, and on Mao and Si days Earth on death or Extinction is imprisoned.

Again, with Fire as the Subject line, when only Water moves on a day that meets Xu, Chen, Chou or Wei, Water is controlled by Earth and it does not matter; at the first sight of You or Shen life is at an end, and only if one hopes for Yin or Mao is the body safe.

If the Subject line sits in a weak place and Wood changes into Metal's country, and the hexagram has no Hai or Zi or a thriving Resource line, rescue is hard, and to find on what day it meets Metal is to decide at what time the coffin is made.
If Metal is Void, it is not judged so, and when the solar term reaches Hai and Zi life is restored, and if one examines which line moves and which is still, one knows on which day one lives or dies.

Among these are those who, greedy for generation, forget control, or are harmed at the place of rescue, and fullness and emptiness must be examined finely: how can they be judged by the common general rule?

note.yi: 这一段是全部五行—地支推算的例子，密度很高，原文有几处文字可疑：头一句「畏土纵金」的「纵」（放过、让金存在）按上下文译作「让金」；「疑此病以方痊」的「疑」按字面译；第五句的「假令金藏土下，飞能生伏为佳」是说金是用神、藏在土爻之下，土（飞）生金（伏）则好；「用居衰木化入金乡」是用神为木，木变入金地（被金克）；「卦无亥子父兴」的「父」是父爻；「查何日逢金，便决何时作殡」是说用神为木时，金克木，遇金的日子就是死期；这段的含意是逐个五行说清「怕什么、喜什么」，不是要背下每个时辰。「节产亥子」的「产」疑是「交」之误（节气交到亥、子），读法没有把握。
note.en: This passage is a run of cases reckoned by the five phases and the branches, and dense; a few readings in the original are doubtful: in the first line, 'fears Earth and lets Metal (zong jin)' is rendered from the context as 'lets Metal be'; 'suspects this illness will then be cured' is translated literally; in 'if Metal hides under Earth, it is good if the flying line can generate the hidden one' Metal is the Subject hidden under an Earth line, and Earth (flying) generating Metal (hidden) is good; 'the Subject sits in a weak place and Wood changes into Metal's country' means the Subject is Wood and it changes into a Metal place (controlled by Metal); the 'father' in 'no Hai or Zi or a thriving father' is the Resource line; 'to find on what day it meets Metal is to decide at what time the coffin is made' means that when the Subject is Wood, Metal controls Wood and the day it meets Metal is the day of death; the sense of the passage is to say for each phase in turn 'what it fears and what it welcomes', not to memorise every hour. The 'chan' in 'when the solar term reaches (chan) Hai and Zi' looks like an error for 'jiao' (arrives), and the reading is uncertain.

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 占自己病断之二：先凭世象次凭卦身；怕月破旬空，喜生扶拱合；克世为忌客、生世为元神，随官入墓灾难瘥、助鬼伤身命必沉；世落空辨缓急、休囚被克无救则天年命尽、旺相无生助亦无所害；他人病身世随官入墓不必忌，命随鬼入墓即凶；卦身墓绝于月建或变爻决无救

rule.yi: 自己占病，先凭世爻的象，再凭卦身，怕遇上月破、旬空，喜欢见到生、扶、拱、合；克世的爻是忌客，来生世的象是元神；随官入墓，灾难痊愈；助鬼伤身，命必沉沦。注说：自己占自己的病，专看世，爻如果临月破，不论新病旧病，命也难保全。世如果落空，要分缓急：急症还能医，旧病就不救；如果空中有气，眼下无妨，后来难保。世象不临旬空月破，再看旺衰：世如果休囚，又被动爻来克、或遭日月来伤、或变成死绝，毫无救助的爻，怎么会不是天年命尽？世即使休囚，如果得到动爻生助、或遇日月扶持、或变为有气，纵然临危也不会死；世如果旺相，虽然没有生助的爻，也没有什么害处。凡是克世的叫忌象，宜静不宜动；生世的叫元神，宜旺不宜空。占他人的病，身、世随官入墓，不必忌讳，命随鬼入墓就凶了。只有自己占身、世，命随鬼入墓的命不会回生，助鬼伤身也是同样的道理；又看卦身，如果墓、绝于月建，或者墓、绝于变爻，一定没有救了。
rule.en: In divining one's own illness, first rely on the image of the Self, then on the Body; it fears meeting Month-break or Void, and is glad to see generation, support, flanking and combination; the line that controls the Self is the adversary guest, and the image that comes to generate it is the Support; following the Pressure line into a tomb, the illness is hard to cure; helping the ghost to harm the Self, life surely sinks. The commentary says: in divining one's own illness, look at the Self alone; if the Self line sits in Month-break, whether the illness is new or old, life is hard to preserve. If the Self is Void, distinguish slow from urgent: an urgent illness can still be treated, an old illness is not saved; if there is qi in the Void, there is no harm for the moment, but later it is hard to keep. If the Self image does not sit in Void or Month-break, look next at strength and weakness: if the Self is resting or trapped and is controlled by a moving line, or wounded by the Day or Month, or changes into death or Extinction, with no line of rescue at all, how can it be anything but the end of one's allotted years? Though the Self is resting or trapped, if a moving line generates and helps it, or the Day and Month support it, or it changes into qi, even at the brink it does not die; if the Self is strong, even without a generating line there is no harm. Whatever controls the Self is called an adversary image and should be still, not moving; whatever generates the Self is called the Support and should be strong, not Void. In divining another's illness, the Body and Self following the Pressure line into a tomb need not be feared, but the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb is ominous. Only in divining for oneself, with the Body and Self, does a natal branch following the ghost into a tomb mean life will not be restored, and helping the ghost to harm the Self is the same in principle; look also at the Body: if it is in a tomb or Extinction under the Month, or in a tomb or Extinction under the changed line, there is surely no rescue.

zh: 自卜身宫疾病临，先凭世象次凭身，
怕逢月破旬空内，喜见生扶拱合亲。
克世之爻为忌客，来生之象作元神，
随官入墓灾难瘥，助鬼伤身命必沉。
yi: 自己占病，先凭世爻的象，再凭卦身，
怕遇上月破、旬空，喜欢见到生、扶、拱、合；
克世的爻是忌客，来生世的象是元神；
随官入墓，灾难痊愈；助鬼伤身，命必沉沦。
en: In divining one's own illness, first rely on the image of the Self, then on the Body;
it fears meeting Month-break or Void, and is glad to see generation, support, flanking and combination;
the line that controls the Self is the adversary guest, and the image that comes to generate it is the Support;
following the Pressure line into a tomb, the illness is hard to cure; helping the ghost to harm the Self, life surely sinks.

zh: 自占己病，专看世，爻若临月故不拘新旧之病命亦难全。
世若落空当明缓急，急症堪医，旧病不救。
若空中有气，目下无妨后来难保。
世象不临旬空月破，又看旺衰，世若休囚却被动爻相克、或遭日月来伤，或变为死绝，毫无救助之爻，岂不天年命尽？
世纵休囚，若得动爻生助，或逢日月扶持、或化为有气，纵临危而不死。
世若旺相虽无生助之爻，亦无所害。
凡克世者名曰忌象，宜静不宜动，生世者名曰元神，宜旺不宜空。
占他人之病，身世随官入墓，不必忌之，命随鬼入墓即凶矣！
惟独自占身世，命随鬼入墓者命不回生，其中助鬼伤身理亦同也。
又看卦身，若墓绝子月建或墓绝于变爻，决无救矣！
yi: 自己占自己的病，专看世，爻如果临月破，不论新病旧病，命也难保全。
世如果落空，要分缓急：急症还能医，旧病就不救。
如果空中有气，眼下无妨，后来难保。
世象不临旬空月破，再看旺衰：世如果休囚，又被动爻来克、或遭日月来伤、或变成死绝，毫无救助的爻，怎么会不是天年命尽？
世即使休囚，如果得到动爻生助、或遇日月扶持、或变为有气，纵然临危也不会死。
世如果旺相，虽然没有生助的爻，也没有什么害处。
凡是克世的叫忌象，宜静不宜动；生世的叫元神，宜旺不宜空。
占他人的病，身、世随官入墓，不必忌讳，命随鬼入墓就凶了。
只有自己占身、世，命随鬼入墓的命不会回生，助鬼伤身也是同样的道理。
又看卦身，如果墓、绝于月建，或者墓、绝于变爻，一定没有救了。
en: In divining one's own illness, look at the Self alone; if the Self line sits in Month-break, whether the illness is new or old, life is hard to preserve.
If the Self is Void, distinguish slow from urgent: an urgent illness can still be treated, an old illness is not saved.
If there is qi in the Void, there is no harm for the moment, but later it is hard to keep.

If the Self image does not sit in Void or Month-break, look next at strength and weakness: if the Self is resting or trapped and is controlled by a moving line, or wounded by the Day or Month, or changes into death or Extinction, with no line of rescue at all, how can it be anything but the end of one's allotted years?
Though the Self is resting or trapped, if a moving line generates and helps it, or the Day and Month support it, or it changes into qi, even at the brink it does not die.
If the Self is strong, even without a generating line there is no harm.
Whatever controls the Self is called an adversary image and should be still, not moving; whatever generates the Self is called the Support and should be strong, not Void.
In divining another's illness, the Body and Self following the Pressure line into a tomb need not be feared, but the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb is ominous.

Only in divining for oneself, with the Body and Self, does a natal branch following the ghost into a tomb mean life will not be restored, and helping the ghost to harm the Self is the same in principle.
Look also at the Body: if it is in a tomb or Extinction under the Month, or in a tomb or Extinction under the changed line, there is surely no rescue.

note.yi: 「爻若临月故」的「故」疑是「破」之误（月破），这里按上下文译作月破。「拱、合」是拱夹和六合。「天年命尽」是寿数到了。这一条把占自己病的判据收成一张单：世（不临月破旬空，看旺衰，休囚要有生助）、忌象（克世，宜静）、元神（生世，宜旺）、随官入墓与助鬼伤身、卦身（墓绝于月建或变爻则无救）。「占他人之病，身世随官入墓不必忌之，命随鬼入墓即凶矣」把黄金策里「随官入墓」的用法限定在了自占；与易冒 LY.ILL.YM.20（己疾世为用神，助伤只对世成立）读法一致。
note.en: The 'gu' in 'if the line sits in month gu' looks like an error for 'break' (Month-break) and is translated so from the context. 'Flanking and combination' are the flank (sandwiching) and the six combinations. 'The end of one's allotted years' is the running-out of the span of life. This entry gathers the criteria for divining one's own illness into one sheet: the Self (not in Month-break or Void; look at strength, and if resting or trapped it needs generation and support), the adversary image (controlling the Self, should be still), the Support (generating the Self, should be strong), following the Pressure line into a tomb and helping the ghost to harm the Self, and the Body (in a tomb or Extinction under the Month or the changed line means no rescue). 'In divining another's illness, the Body and Self following the Pressure line into a tomb need not be feared, and the natal branch following the ghost into a tomb is ominous' confines the Huangjin Ce's 'following the Pressure line into a tomb' to divining for oneself, and agrees with the Yi Mao's LY.ILL.YM.20 (the Self is the Subject in one's own illness, and helping to harm holds only for the Self).

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 占他人病断之三：代占他人以应爻为用——临月破旬空其命难保，衰弱遭动象日月伤或变墓绝便凶，应纵休囚得变生旺或动爻日月相扶命还有救；生应为元神宜动、克应为忌客宜空；鬼临应上病必难痊；卦身不可临月破、不可成墓绝之乡

rule.yi: 替别人问，看应爻，如果临月破最难逃过；遇冲遇克，人难救；逢旺逢生，病必消；生应的元神宜发动，克它的忌象怕交重；卦身有气，还是吉；应位遇上官鬼，祸必招来。注说：替别人占病，应作用爻，如果临月破、旬空，他的命难保；应如果衰弱，又遭动象或日月来伤、或应变成墓绝，就主凶危；应即使休囚，如果变为生旺、或有动爻和日月相扶，命还有救。凡是生应的爻是元神，宜动；克应的象是忌客，宜空。鬼临在应上，病一定难痊。再察卦身，也不可临月破，又不可成墓绝之乡；卦身或墓、或绝于月建之中，都是凶兆。
rule.en: In asking for another, look at the Other line; if it sits in Month-break, it is hardest to escape; meeting clash or control, the person is hard to save; meeting strength or generation, the illness surely dissolves; the Support that generates the Other should move, and the adversary image that controls it fears moving; if the Body has qi it is still auspicious; if Pressure meets the place of the Other, misfortune is sure to be invited. The commentary says: in divining another's illness, the Other is the Subject line; if it sits in Month-break or Void, his life is hard to keep; if the Other is weak and is wounded by a moving image or by the Day and Month, or the Other changes into a tomb or Extinction, it means danger; though the Other is resting or trapped, if it changes into generation or strength, or a moving line and the Day and Month support it, life can still be saved. Whatever generates the Other is the Support and should move; whatever controls the Other is the adversary guest and should be Void. With the ghost on the Other, the illness is surely hard to cure. Then examine the Body: it must not sit in Month-break, nor become a place of tomb or Extinction; if the Body is in a tomb or in Extinction under the Month, both are ominous signs.

zh: 代问他人看应爻，若临月破最难逃，
遇冲遇克身难救，逢旺逢生病必消，
生应元神宜发动，克他忌象怕重交，
卦身有气还须吉，应位逢官祸必招。
yi: 替别人问，看应爻，如果临月破最难逃过；
遇冲遇克，人难救；逢旺逢生，病必消；
生应的元神宜发动，克它的忌象怕交重；
卦身有气，还是吉；应位遇上官鬼，祸必招来。
en: In asking for another, look at the Other line; if it sits in Month-break, it is hardest to escape;
meeting clash or control, the person is hard to save; meeting strength or generation, the illness surely dissolves;
the Support that generates the Other should move, and the adversary image that controls it fears moving;
if the Body has qi it is still auspicious; if Pressure meets the place of the Other, misfortune is sure to be invited.

zh: 代卜他人之病，应作用爻，如临月破旬空其命难保。
应如衰弱亦遭动象或日月来伤、或应变为墓绝，便主凶危。
应纵休囚，若得变为生旺、或动爻及日月相扶，命还有救。
凡生应之爻是元神而宜动，克应之象乃忌客而宜空。
鬼临应上病必难痊。
次察卦身，亦不可临于月破，又不可成墓绝之乡。
卦身或墓、或绝于月建之中，皆为凶兆也。
yi: 替别人占病，应作用爻，如果临月破、旬空，他的命难保。
应如果衰弱，又遭动象或日月来伤、或应变成墓绝，就主凶危。
应即使休囚，如果变为生旺、或有动爻和日月相扶，命还有救。
凡是生应的爻是元神，宜动；克应的象是忌客，宜空。
鬼临在应上，病一定难痊。
再察卦身，也不可临月破，又不可成墓绝之乡。
卦身或墓、或绝于月建之中，都是凶兆。
en: In divining another's illness, the Other is the Subject line; if it sits in Month-break or Void, his life is hard to keep.
If the Other is weak and is wounded by a moving image or by the Day and Month, or the Other changes into a tomb or Extinction, it means danger.
Though the Other is resting or trapped, if it changes into generation or strength, or a moving line and the Day and Month support it, life can still be saved.
Whatever generates the Other is the Support and should move; whatever controls the Other is the adversary guest and should be Void.
With the ghost on the Other, the illness is surely hard to cure.
Then examine the Body: it must not sit in Month-break, nor become a place of tomb or Extinction.
If the Body is in a tomb or in Extinction under the Month, both are ominous signs.

note.yi: 「占他人之病，应作用爻」是易林补遗的定则（见 LY.ILL.EL.21 的最后两句：「占自己取世为用爻，占他人取应为用爻」）；但第 LY.ILL.EL.21 表里又按占的是谁另取用神（占父母取父母、占子取子孙……），两条并存：应爻是代占时的通用用爻，六亲各有自己的用神。原文在注的第一段「应如衰弱亦遭动象」处缺一个「若」字，不影响意思。这一条与黄金策「占他人：身世随官入墓不必忌」（LY.ILL.HJC.41）是同一路读法，也与易隐取用爻一条（LY.ILL.YY.03）的「代占以应爻为用」一致。
note.en: 'In divining another's illness, the Other is the Subject line' is the Yilin Buyi's standing rule (see the last two sentences of LY.ILL.EL.21: 'in divining oneself take the Self as the Subject line, in divining another take the Other'); but the table in LY.ILL.EL.21 also takes a Subject by the person divined (a parent takes the Resource line, a son the Output line, and so on), and the two stand together: the Other is the general Subject line when one divines for another, and each of the six relations has its own Subject. The original omits a word before 'the Other if weak' in the first part of the commentary, which does not affect the sense. It reads in the same way as the Huangjin Ce's 'in divining another, the Body and Self following the Pressure line into a tomb need not be feared' (LY.ILL.HJC.41) and agrees with the Yi Yin's entry on taking the Subject line, 'divining for another takes the Other line as the Subject' (LY.ILL.YY.03).

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 占何日病退：用临生旺体当安、元神值日灾须减、忌象遭伤病必痊、助鬼伤身逢福解、随官入墓见冲欢、主象临绝待生时；元神旺相忌客休囚取用爻值日、用爻衰弱取生旺之期、用爻太旺反喜入墓之时、不太旺取元神值日、忌神动逢冲克忌神之日

rule.yi: 凡是占病人哪一天痊愈，用爻临在生旺上，身体应当安好；元神值日，灾应减轻；忌象受伤，病必痊愈；助鬼伤身，遇到福解（福神来解）；随官入墓，见冲就欢喜；如果主象落在绝地，就等它逢生的时候，免去祸愆。注说：占病哪一天痊愈，要推主象。卦里元神旺相、忌客休囚而有用爻的，就取用爻值日的那天安好；如果用爻衰弱，才取生旺的时期。倘若用爻重重太旺，反而喜欢它入墓的时候；如果不太旺，又取元神值日；忌神如果动，必须遇上冲克忌神的日子，才能安康。若遇助鬼伤身，又利于子孙值日。随官入墓，还要求冲开墓的日辰。用象如果临在绝地而逢生，一定主平安。
rule.en: To divine on what day a patient recovers: with the Subject line on generation or strength, the body should be well; on the day of the Support the calamity should lessen; when the adversary image is wounded the illness surely heals; helping the ghost to harm the Self is resolved by meeting the fortune spirit; following the Pressure line into a tomb is glad to meet a clash; if the chief image sits in Extinction, wait for the time it is born, and misfortune is avoided. The commentary says: to divine on what day the illness is cured, work out the chief image. If in the hexagram the Support is strong and the adversary guest resting or trapped and there is a Subject line, take the day on which the Subject line is on duty for ease; if the Subject line is weak, take a period of generation or strength. If the Subject line is far too strong, on the contrary it is glad of the time it enters a tomb; if it is not too strong, take the day of the Support; if the Adversary moves, one must meet the day that clashes and controls the Adversary before health returns. Meeting helping the ghost to harm the Self, the day of Output on duty is again favourable. Following the Pressure line into a tomb, seek further a day that clashes the tomb open. If the Subject image sits in Extinction and meets generation, it surely means peace.

zh: 凡卜病人何日瘥，用临生旺体当安，
元神值日灾须减，忌象遭伤病必痊，
助鬼伤身逢福解，随官入墓见冲欢，
若然主象临其绝，且待生时免祸愆。
yi: 凡是占病人哪一天痊愈，用爻临在生旺上，身体应当安好；
元神值日，灾应减轻；忌象受伤，病必痊愈；
助鬼伤身，遇到福神来解；随官入墓，见冲就欢喜；
如果主象落在绝地，就等它逢生的时候，免去祸愆。
en: To divine on what day a patient recovers: with the Subject line on generation or strength, the body should be well;
on the day of the Support the calamity should lessen; when the adversary image is wounded the illness surely heals;
helping the ghost to harm the Self is resolved by meeting the fortune spirit; following the Pressure line into a tomb is glad to meet a clash;
if the chief image sits in Extinction, wait for the time it is born, and misfortune is avoided.

zh: 占病何日得痊，须推主象。
卦中元神旺相，忌客休囚得无用爻者，便取用爻值日而安卦中，如有用爻而衰弱者，方取生旺之期。
倘若用爻重重太旺者，反喜入墓之时，如不太旺又取元神值日，忌神若动，须逢冲克忌神之日，方得安康。
若逢助鬼伤身又利子孙值日。
随官入墓，还求冲墓之辰。
用象如临绝地逢生，必主乎宁。
yi: 占病哪一天痊愈，要推主象。
卦里元神旺相、忌客休囚而有用爻的，就取用爻值日的那天安好；如果用爻衰弱，才取生旺的时期。
倘若用爻重重太旺，反而喜欢它入墓的时候；如果不太旺，又取元神值日；忌神如果动，必须遇上冲克忌神的日子，才能安康。
若遇助鬼伤身，又利于子孙值日。
随官入墓，还要求冲开墓的日辰。
用象如果临在绝地而逢生，一定主平安。
en: To divine on what day the illness is cured, work out the chief image.

If in the hexagram the Support is strong and the adversary guest resting or trapped and there is a Subject line, take the day on which the Subject line is on duty for ease; if the Subject line is weak, take a period of generation or strength.

If the Subject line is far too strong, on the contrary it is glad of the time it enters a tomb; if it is not too strong, take the day of the Support; if the Adversary moves, one must meet the day that clashes and controls the Adversary before health returns.
Meeting helping the ghost to harm the Self, the day of Output on duty is again favourable.
Following the Pressure line into a tomb, seek further a day that clashes the tomb open.
If the Subject image sits in Extinction and meets generation, it surely means peace.

note.yi: 「福解」（福神来解）指子孙发动或值日来解开助鬼伤身的凶；「体当安」的「体」是身体。「用爻重重太旺，反喜入墓之时」是说太旺的用爻要靠入墓来泄它的过旺，与黄金策「用壮有扶切恐太刚则折」（LY.ILL.HJC.36）是同一路道理：占病不喜太旺。这一条和黄金策的应期（LY.ILL.HJC.57）、增删卜易的应期（LY.ILL.ZS.16）、易隐愈日（LY.ILL.YY.04）、易冒问安日（LY.ILL.YM.19）是同一件事，几家取日的办法大体一致：取用神（元神）生旺值日、冲克忌神之日、冲开墓库之日。
note.en: 'Resolved by meeting the fortune spirit' means Output moving or on duty resolves the ill of helping the ghost to harm the Self; the 'body' in 'the body should be well' is the physical body. 'The Subject line far too strong is on the contrary glad of the time it enters a tomb' means that an over-strong Subject line needs to enter a tomb to be drained of its excess, the same reasoning as the Huangjin Ce's 'the Subject strong and supported, fearing it is too rigid and breaks' (LY.ILL.HJC.36): in divining illness one does not welcome too much strength. This entry is the same matter as the Huangjin Ce's timing (LY.ILL.HJC.57), the Zengshan Buyi's timing (LY.ILL.ZS.16), the Yi Yin's days of recovery (LY.ILL.YY.04) and the Yi Mao's days of ease (LY.ILL.YM.19), and the books agree in outline on how to take the day: the day the Subject (or Support) is strong and on duty, the day that clashes and controls the Adversary, the day that clashes the tomb open.

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 占何日病凶：用爻无气更遭伤、忌爻逢生助之日便主身危；忌神旺动仇人发而无用爻则待用神值日难避；月破用爻不拘衰旺命必归阴；元神被克灾加重、忌客逢生定受殃——书中九例(观之益、涣之垢、剥、萃、师、艮、归妹……)

rule.yi: 病人来占，要细看凶日：用爻无气，又遭伤克，忌爻哪天逢到生助，便主身危，立在孝堂；忌神旺动、仇神发动，用神失位反而无妨；变爻怕日辰临在用爻的位置，如果挨过去就免于凄惶；元神被克灾更重，忌客逢生一定受殃；月破用爻，天命就止，纵然旺相也必死。注说：论病哪一天出现凶险，不过看用爻的生克：用爻如果无气、被日辰克的就凶，忌神动、用爻很衰的时候，遇上再生忌神的日子就死；又说卦里元神不发，忌神兴旺、仇神都动，唯独没有用爻，眼前无事，等到日后用神值日就难以回避，一定入黄泉；倘若忌神、仇神兴旺而元神同时发动，也没有主象，等到用爻值日反而无妨；再说卦里用象既衰，全靠元神相救，担心忌客来伤，日辰克制元神，灾就沉重；忌象如果逢生旺的时候，一定成凶咎；主象如果逢月破，不论衰旺，命必归阴。
rule.en: For a patient who comes to divine, examine the ominous days closely: with the Subject line lacking qi and moreover wounded, on the day the adversary line meets generation and support the body is in danger, standing in the house of mourning; the Adversary strong and moving and the enemy spirit rising, the Subject having lost its place is on the contrary all right; a change fears the Day sitting on the Subject's place, and if it is got past there is freedom from dismay; the Support controlled makes the calamity heavier, and the adversary guest meeting generation surely brings disaster; the Subject line in Month-break ends one's allotted span, and even if strong it will die. The commentary says: to judge on what day the illness turns ominous is nothing but looking at the generation and control of the Subject line: if the Subject line has no qi and is controlled by the Day it is ominous, and when the Adversary moves and the Subject line is very weak, meeting a day that again generates the Adversary means death; again, if in the hexagram the Support does not move, the Adversary thrives and the enemy spirit all move, and there is only no Subject line, nothing happens for now, but when the Subject's day comes it is hard to avoid and he surely enters the Yellow Springs; if the Adversary and enemy spirit thrive and the Support moves with them, and there is also no chief image, then waiting until the Subject line's day is on the contrary harmless; moreover, if the Subject image in the hexagram is already weak, everything depends on the Support to rescue it, and one worries that the adversary guest will come to wound it, and if the Day controls the Support the calamity will be heavy; if the adversary image meets a time of generation or strength it is sure to make misfortune; if the chief image meets Month-break, whether strong or weak, life must return to the shades.

zh: 病者来占凶日详，用爻无气更遭伤，
忌爻那日逢生助，便主身危立孝堂。
忌神旺动仇人发，用神失位反无妨，
变怕日辰临用地，若还挨过免凄惶，
元神被克灾加重，忌客逢生定受殃，
月破用爻天命止，纵然旺相也须亡。
yi: 病人来占，要细看凶日：用爻无气，又遭伤克，
忌爻哪天逢到生助，便主身危，立在孝堂；
忌神旺动、仇神发动，用神失位反而无妨；
变爻怕日辰临在用爻的位置，如果挨过去就免于凄惶；
元神被克灾更重，忌客逢生一定受殃；
月破用爻，天命就止，纵然旺相也必死。
en: For a patient who comes to divine, examine the ominous days closely: with the Subject line lacking qi and moreover wounded,
on the day the adversary line meets generation and support the body is in danger, standing in the house of mourning;
the Adversary strong and moving and the enemy spirit rising, the Subject having lost its place is on the contrary all right;
a change fears the Day sitting on the Subject's place, and if it is got past there is freedom from dismay;
the Support controlled makes the calamity heavier, and the adversary guest meeting generation surely brings disaster;
the Subject line in Month-break ends one's allotted span, and even if strong it will die.

zh: 论病何日见凶，不过看用爻生克，用如无气被日辰克者为凶，忌动用衰甚日再生忌神者死。
又论卦中元神不发，忌神兴仇神皆动，独无用爻，日前无事，待后用神值日难以回避，定入黄泉。
倘若忌神仇神兴元神同发，亦无主象，候至用爻值日反主无妨，复陈卦内用象既衰，全赖元神相救，能忧忌客来伤，日辰克制元神，灾当沉重。
忌象如逢生旺之时定成凶咎。
主象如逢月破，不拘衰旺，命必归阴。
yi: 论病哪一天出现凶险，不过看用爻的生克：用爻如果无气、被日辰克的就凶，忌神动、用爻很衰的时候，遇上再生忌神的日子就死。
又说卦里元神不发，忌神兴旺、仇神都动，唯独没有用爻，眼前无事，等到日后用神值日就难以回避，一定入黄泉。
倘若忌神、仇神兴旺而元神同时发动，也没有主象，等到用爻值日反而无妨；再说卦里用象既衰，全靠元神相救，担心忌客来伤，日辰克制元神，灾就沉重。
忌象如果逢生旺的时候，一定成凶咎。
主象如果逢月破，不论衰旺，命必归阴。
en: To judge on what day the illness turns ominous is nothing but looking at the generation and control of the Subject line: if the Subject line has no qi and is controlled by the Day it is ominous, and when the Adversary moves and the Subject line is very weak, meeting a day that again generates the Adversary means death.

Again, if in the hexagram the Support does not move, the Adversary thrives and the enemy spirit all move, and there is only no Subject line, nothing happens for now, but when the Subject's day comes it is hard to avoid and he surely enters the Yellow Springs.

If the Adversary and enemy spirit thrive and the Support moves with them, and there is also no chief image, then waiting until the Subject line's day is on the contrary harmless; moreover, if the Subject image in the hexagram is already weak, everything depends on the Support to rescue it, and one worries that the adversary guest will come to wound it, and if the Day controls the Support the calamity will be heavy.
If the adversary image meets a time of generation or strength it is sure to make misfortune.
If the chief image meets Month-break, whether strong or weak, life must return to the shades.

zh: 且如子占父病，五月甲子日，占得观之益卦，此卦父爻化居旺地，又带青龙贵人，本为吉象，岂知父临月破，后至乙亥日，元神绝而忌神生，果然父丧。
又如妻占夫病，三月甲子旬丁卯日，卜得涣之垢卦，所嫌仇神忌神皆动，独无用爻，又鬼伏仇爻之下，又值旬空，毫无救。
挨至乙亥日用爻透出，免受忌神来伤，夫果死也。
假令弟占兄病，十月戊辰日，卜得剥初二三爻皆动，却本卦无兄弟，所喜申金兄弟伏在世爻用爻透出果应病痊。
又如父占子病，五月甲午旬癸卯日，占得萃卦上六爻动，此卦子孙太弱，父母相而又动，虽受卯日相伤，又逢月建扶起，父又化为进气能克用爻，虽有元神暗动又值立时空不能相救，后至丙午日忌象叨生，此男果死。
又如夫占妻病，三月甲戌旬庚辰日，卜得师卦九二上六爻动，此卦青龙财爻持世，兄弟又不交重，鬼又化出财来，本为佳兆，岂知土官发动，书云更论土爻临鬼动，多凶少吉祸难让，果应五月庚申日，官遇长生月建又扶土鬼，此鬼太刚死而可验。
又如父占女久远病，七月甲寅旬癸亥日，卜得艮卦安静，此卦用爻临月建，忌神又不兴似无凶兆，岂知卦犯六冲，经云初灾遇此当瘵瘥，久病逢之命必伤，果应在子月戊午日，用象死于月建，败于日辰，其女死也。
又母占子病，九月甲子旬辛未日，卜得归妹卦安静，此卦六爻无子，虽伏出亥水子孙在四爻之下，又落空亡，世上父母又被日辰冲动本绝卦也，岂知互出水火既济取互体坎水配成兑卦，子孙此乃无中生有也。
惟互出之爻，再不受日月并动爻伤克，此子果应亥月戊子日，用值旺乡，病全脱体。
yi: 比如儿子占父亲的病，五月甲子日，占得观卦变益卦，这一卦父爻化出旺地，又带青龙、贵人，本来是吉象，哪知道父爻临月破，后来到乙亥日，元神绝而忌神生，果然父亲去世。
又如妻子占丈夫的病，三月甲子旬丁卯日，占得涣卦变垢卦，所嫌的是仇神、忌神都动，唯独没有用爻，又鬼伏在仇神爻之下，又值旬空，毫无救助。
挨到乙亥日用爻透出，免受忌神来伤，丈夫果然死了。
假如弟弟占哥哥的病，十月戊辰日，占得剥卦初、二、三爻都动，可是本卦没有兄弟爻，所幸申金兄弟爻伏在世爻之下、用爻透出，果然应验病愈。
又如父亲占儿子的病，五月甲午旬癸卯日，占得萃卦上六爻动，这一卦子孙太弱，父母爻旺相又动，虽然受卯日相伤，又逢月建扶起，父爻又化为进气，能克用爻，虽然有元神暗动，又值立时空，不能相救，后来到丙午日忌象叨生，这个男孩果然死了。
又如丈夫占妻子的病，三月甲戌旬庚辰日，占得师卦九二、上六爻动，这一卦青龙财爻持世，兄弟爻又不发动，鬼又变出财来，本是佳兆，哪知道土官发动，书上说更论土爻临鬼动，多凶少吉祸难禳，果然应在五月庚申日，官遇长生、月建又扶土鬼，这个鬼太刚，死而验证。
又如父亲占女儿的久病，七月甲寅旬癸亥日，占得艮卦安静，这一卦用爻临月建，忌神又不发动，似乎没有凶兆，哪知道卦犯六冲，经上说初灾遇此当全好，久病遇上命必伤，果然应在子月戊午日，用象死于月建、败于日辰，这个女儿死了。
又如母亲占儿子的病，九月甲子旬辛未日，占得归妹卦安静，这一卦六爻里没有子孙，虽然伏出亥水子孙在四爻之下，又落空亡，世上的父母爻又被日辰冲动，本来是绝卦，哪知道互出水火既济，取互体坎水配成兑卦，子孙这就是无中生有。
只有互卦里出来的爻，再不受日、月和动爻的伤克，这个儿子果然应在亥月戊子日，用爻逢旺，病全部脱体。
en: For example, a son divined his father's illness on a Jiazi day in the fifth month and obtained Guan changing into Yi; in this hexagram the Resource line changed into a strong place and carried the Azure Dragon and the Noble, which would have been an auspicious image, but who would have known that the Resource line sat in Month-break, and later on the Yihai day the Support was in Extinction and the Adversary generated, and the father indeed died.

Again, a wife divined her husband's illness on a Dingmao day of the Jiazi decade in the third month and obtained Huan changing into Gou; what was disliked was that the enemy spirit and the Adversary both moved, and only the Subject line was missing, the ghost was moreover hidden under the enemy-spirit line and in Void as well, with no rescue at all.
It was held off until the Yihai day, when the Subject line came out and was spared the Adversary's wounding, and the husband indeed died.

Suppose a younger brother divined his elder brother's illness on a Wuchen day in the tenth month and obtained Bo with the first, second and third lines all moving, but the main hexagram had no Peer line; happily the Shen Metal Peer line lay hidden under the Self and the Subject line came out, and it came true that the illness was cured.

Again, a father divined his son's illness on a Guimao day of the Jiawu decade in the fifth month and obtained Cui with the top line moving; in this hexagram Output was too weak, the Resource line was strong and moving, and though wounded by the Mao day it was raised by the Month, and the Resource line also changed into advancing qi and could control the Subject line; though the Support moved in secret it was Void at the moment and could not rescue, and later on the Bingwu day the adversary image drew generation, and the boy indeed died.

Again, a husband divined his wife's illness on a Gengchen day of the Jiaxu decade in the third month and obtained Shi with the second line and the top line moving; in this hexagram the Azure Dragon Wealth line held the Self, the Peer line did not move, and the ghost changed into Wealth, which was an auspicious sign, but who would have known that the Earth Pressure line moved, and the book says 'an Earth line on a moving ghost is mostly ominous and seldom auspicious, and the misfortune is hard to exorcise', and it came true on the Gengshen day in the fifth month, the Pressure line meeting Birth and the Month again supporting the Earth ghost; the ghost was too rigid, and her death confirmed it.

Again, a father divined his daughter's long illness on a Guihai day of the Jiayin decade in the seventh month and obtained Gen still; in this hexagram the Subject line sat in the Month and the Adversary did not move, so there seemed no ominous sign, but who would have known that the hexagram committed a six-clash, and the classic says 'a fresh calamity meeting it should be wholly cured, a long illness meeting it surely brings harm to life', and it came true on a Wuwu day in the Zi month, the Subject image dying to the Month and defeated by the Day, and the daughter died.

Again, a mother divined her son's illness on a Xinwei day of the Jiazi decade in the ninth month and obtained Guimei still; in this hexagram there was no Output among the six lines, and although Hai Water Output came out hidden under the fourth line it was in Void, and the Resource line on the Self was clashed into motion by the Day, so it was a hopeless hexagram, but who would have known that Jiji came out of the nuclear trigrams, taking the nuclear Kan Water to join with Dui, and Output was thus born from nothing.

Only the line that comes out of the nuclear trigrams is no longer wounded or controlled by the Day, Month or moving lines, and the son indeed answered on a Wuzi day in the Hai month, the Subject line meeting strength and the illness wholly leaving the body.

note.yi: 这一条前半是规则，后半是九个卦例。卦例里最后一个（归妹静卦，互出水火既济，取互卦的坎水配兑）是「卦无用象，查互卦」（LY.ILL.EL.10）那条规则的实例：主卦里没有子孙，伏神空，却从互卦里取出了亥水子孙，而且互出来的爻不受日月动爻的伤克，所以病愈。第五个例（萃卦）里的「立时空」与 LY.ILL.EL.11 里的是同一个词。卦例里的「进气」即化进神。「立孝堂」「归阴」都是死的委婉说法。各例的月日和卦都是原文的，没有替它排过盘。
note.en: The first half of this entry is rules and the second half nine cases. The last of the cases (Guimei still, with Jiji from the nuclear trigrams, taking the nuclear Kan Water to join Dui) is an instance of the rule 'if the hexagram has no Subject image, examine the nuclear trigrams' (LY.ILL.EL.10): the main hexagram has no Output and the hidden line is Void, yet Hai Water Output is taken from the nuclear trigrams, and the line that comes out of the nuclear trigrams is not wounded by the Day, Month or moving lines, so the illness is cured. 'Void at the moment' in the fifth case is the same word as in LY.ILL.EL.11. 'Advancing qi' in the cases is a change into an Advancing line. 'Standing in the house of mourning' and 'returning to the shades' are euphemisms for death. The months, days and hexagrams of the cases are the original's, and no chart has been cast for them.

units.chapter_en: On generation and control in illness
units.title: 各类所占之人的用神、元神、忌神、仇神、泄气：占父母尊长——父母为用官鬼为元妻财为忌子孙为仇兄弟泄；占兄弟朋友、占子孙卑幼、占妻妾奴婢、占夫主官员各有其表；自己取世、他人取应；此法非惟占病，凡看卦无不用之

rule.yi: 占父母及家主尊长之类，取父母爻为用神，官鬼为元神，妻财为忌神，子孙为仇神，兄弟为泄气；占兄弟朋友之类，兄弟为用神，父母为元神，官鬼为忌神，妻财为仇神，子孙为泄气；占子孙卑幼之类，子孙为用神，兄弟为元神，父母为忌神，官鬼为仇神，妻财为泄气；占妻妾、弟媳子媳奴婢之类，妻财为用神，子孙为元神，兄弟为忌神，父母为仇神，官鬼为泄气；占丈夫、官员之类，官鬼为用神，妻财为元神，子孙为忌神，兄弟为仇神，父母为泄气；占自己取世作用爻，生世的为元神，克世的为忌神；占他人取应作用爻，生应的为元神，克应的为忌神；这个办法不光占病，凡是看卦，没有不用它的。
rule.en: In divining a parent, or the master of the house or an elder, take the Resource line as the Subject, the Pressure line as the Support, the Wealth line as the Adversary, Output as the enemy spirit and Peer as the drain; in divining a brother or friend, Peer is the Subject, Resource the Support, Pressure the Adversary, Wealth the enemy spirit and Output the drain; in divining a son or a junior, Output is the Subject, Peer the Support, Resource the Adversary, Pressure the enemy spirit and Wealth the drain; in divining a wife, a concubine, a sister-in-law, a daughter-in-law or a maid, Wealth is the Subject, Output the Support, Peer the Adversary, Resource the enemy spirit and Pressure the drain; in divining a husband or an official, Pressure is the Subject, Wealth the Support, Output the Adversary, Peer the enemy spirit and Resource the drain; in divining oneself take the Self as the Subject line, what generates the Self as the Support and what controls the Self as the Adversary; in divining another take the Other as the Subject line, what generates the Other as the Support and what controls the Other as the Adversary; this method is not only for divining illness, and in looking at any hexagram there is none that does not use it.

zh: 凡占父母及家主尊长之类，取父母为用神，官鬼为元神，妻财为忌神、子孙为仇神、兄弟为泄气。
凡占兄弟朋友之类，兄弟为用神，父母为元神，官鬼为忌神，妻财为仇神，子孙为泄气。
凡占子孙卑幼之类，子孙为用神，兄弟为元神，父母为忌神，官鬼为仇神，妻财为泄气。
凡占妻妾、弟妇子室奴婢之类，妻财为用神，子孙为元神，兄弟为忌神，父母为仇神，官鬼为泄气。
凡占夫主、官员之类，官鬼为用神，妻财为元神，子孙为忌神，兄弟为仇神，父母为泄气。
占自己取世为用爻，生世者为元神，克世者为忌神。
占他人取应为用爻，生应者为元神，克应者为忌神。
此法非惟占病，凡看卦，无不用之。
yi: 凡是占父母及家主尊长之类，取父母爻为用神，官鬼为元神，妻财为忌神，子孙为仇神，兄弟为泄气。
凡是占兄弟朋友之类，兄弟为用神，父母为元神，官鬼为忌神，妻财为仇神，子孙为泄气。
凡是占子孙卑幼之类，子孙为用神，兄弟为元神，父母为忌神，官鬼为仇神，妻财为泄气。
凡是占妻妾、弟媳子媳奴婢之类，妻财为用神，子孙为元神，兄弟为忌神，父母为仇神，官鬼为泄气。
凡是占丈夫、官员之类，官鬼为用神，妻财为元神，子孙为忌神，兄弟为仇神，父母为泄气。
占自己取世作用爻，生世的为元神，克世的为忌神。
占他人取应作用爻，生应的为元神，克应的为忌神。
这个办法不光占病，凡是看卦，没有不用它的。
en: In divining a parent, or the master of the house or an elder, take the Resource line as the Subject, the Pressure line as the Support, the Wealth line as the Adversary, Output as the enemy spirit and Peer as the drain.
In divining a brother or friend, Peer is the Subject, Resource the Support, Pressure the Adversary, Wealth the enemy spirit and Output the drain.
In divining a son or a junior, Output is the Subject, Peer the Support, Resource the Adversary, Pressure the enemy spirit and Wealth the drain.
In divining a wife, a concubine, a sister-in-law, a daughter-in-law or a maid, Wealth is the Subject, Output the Support, Peer the Adversary, Resource the enemy spirit and Pressure the drain.
In divining a husband or an official, Pressure is the Subject, Wealth the Support, Output the Adversary, Peer the enemy spirit and Resource the drain.
In divining oneself take the Self as the Subject line, what generates the Self as the Support and what controls the Self as the Adversary.
In divining another take the Other as the Subject line, what generates the Other as the Support and what controls the Other as the Adversary.
This method is not only for divining illness, and in looking at any hexagram there is none that does not use it.

note.yi: 这是全书通用的取用表，写在占病一章里：五类被占的人，每类五个位置——用神（所占者）、元神（生它的）、忌神（克它的）、仇神（生忌神的、克元神的）、泄气（被它生的）。比如占父母，用神是父母爻，生它的官鬼是元神，克它的妻财是忌神，生妻财的子孙是仇神，被它生的兄弟是泄气。「占自己取世、占他人取应」是通则；上面五类是按所占者的身份再细分。这一表与黄金策的用神取法（LY.ILL.HJC.33）、易冒的用神之法（LY.ILL.YM.21 到 YM.23）、易隐的取用爻（LY.ILL.YY.03）相比，五类的划分与常法一致，但没有易冒「主虽少而用父母」那样单独论辈分和亲疏。第一条「占父母及家主尊长」里，家主也取父母爻，与易冒相同（易冒 LY.ILL.YM.21），而与易隐「奴丁占家主取五爻」（LY.ILL.YY.03）不同。
note.en: This is the book's general table for taking the Subject, written in the chapter on illness: five kinds of person divined, each with five positions — Subject (the one divined), Support (what generates it), Adversary (what controls it), enemy spirit (what generates the Adversary, or controls the Support) and drain (what it generates). For example, in divining a parent the Subject is the Resource line, the Pressure line that generates it is the Support, the Wealth line that controls it is the Adversary, Output which generates Wealth is the enemy spirit, and Peer which it generates is the drain. 'In divining oneself take the Self, in divining another the Other' is the general rule; the five kinds above subdivide it by the status of the one divined. Compared with the Huangjin Ce's way of taking the Subject (LY.ILL.HJC.33), the Yi Mao's (LY.ILL.YM.21 to YM.23) and the Yi Yin's line for the Subject (LY.ILL.YY.03), its division into five kinds agrees with the usual method, but it does not go on, as the Yi Mao does, to treat seniority and closeness separately, as in 'a master, though young, takes the Resource line'. In its first item, 'a parent, or the master of the house or an elder', the master also takes the Resource line, as in the Yi Mao (LY.ILL.YM.21), and unlike the Yi Yin's 'servants divining the master of the house take the fifth line' (LY.ILL.YY.03).
